connects_to.relationship: GPU/CPU die delivered for CoWoS advanced packaging

contracts.signal: Asked whether AMD would consider Intel as a foundry partner, CFO Jean Hu said AMD co-develops much of its technology with TSMC, is diversifying geographically with TSMC (a fab in Arizona), and 'you should expect us to continue to view TSMC as our primary supplier on the wafer side.' Matt Ramsay added that for 'anything that’s advanced packaging or anything that’s advanced wafers, we’re going to evaluate and due diligence on technology from every vendor in the market', while the TSMC partnership stays significant for the foreseeable future.
